extras: Not yet published to the Obsidian community plugin registry.
intentEvidence: R2 Media Sync cleans up that class of generated assets automatically.
motivation: Plugins such as EzImage handle pasted or dragged images very well, but some Obsidian workflows create files directly in the vault and write local links into Markdown.
problem: External tools often create local image files within the vault and insert local links, leading to vault clutter and sync storage issues.
summary: R2 Media Sync uploads local media referenced in Markdown notes to Cloudflare R2 and automatically rewrites the local links to public R2 URLs.
